name: column: words that ask for a drawing of what was just said. They count only as a follow-up, after an answer: the same words as a first question are an ordinary ask. Words that say for themselves what the drawing should show do not count, even as a follow-up: "... a quick diagram of how sign in, creating a link, and the click stats connect", "a diagram showing the three parts", "a diagram of the pipeline", and "can you draw how these steps connect?". Nor do the words that ask for the whole thing drawn, which are their own ask

asks: can you draw how these steps connect?
Can you draw me a quick diagram of how sign in, creating a link, and the click stats connect in this build?
Draw out the whole thing for me, start to finish.
Draw a quick diagram of that.
